questions.question: Whom does Psalm 58 address and rebuke?
options: Greedy merchants who cheat with their false scales
False prophets who speak their own dreams
Idle priests who neglect the holy things
Unjust rulers/judges who do not judge uprightly
questions.answer: Unjust rulers/judges who do not judge uprightly

questions.question: To what does David compare the wicked?
options: The venom of a serpent, like a deaf adder
The bite of a wolf among the sheep
The sting of a scorpion hidden in the sand
The roar of a lion stalking its prey
questions.answer: The venom of a serpent, like a deaf adder

questions.question: The psalm declares that mankind will say there is a reward for the righteous and a God who judges the earth.
Surely there is a reward for the _____.
The wicked are estranged from the womb; the _____ go astray from birth.
